bio.text: He spent most of his early to mid-life in the Buddhist monkhood, returning to Nanchang when he was about fifty years old. He embarked on an artistic career soon after reentering secular life in 1680, producing works that featured his calligraphy, painting, and poetry.
Nearly all of these men were, in one way or another, rebels in retirement, actively out of sympathy with the new Dynasty in particular and the world in general.
